pass_gates.rule: Canonical revision-5 CANDIDATES source fixes this parcel seed ID/ref and BNG coordinate.
HMLR INSPIRE download dataset is currently the 5 July 2026 publication.
London Borough of Barnet is listed for current INSPIRE GML download.
London Borough of Enfield is listed for current INSPIRE GML download.
HMLR publishes replacement INSPIRE files on the first Sunday of each month.
INSPIRE polygons show position and indicative extent, not exact legal boundary.
Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title.
HMLR INSPIRE geometry is captured against British National Grid/EPSG:27700; native BNG is required for identity matching.
EA Composite DTM is terrain-only, approximately 99% England, 1m raster and remains the primary numeric surface source.
EA Composite DTM is metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn/OSTN15 and contributing surveys are +/-15cm RMSE vertically.
EA Time Stamped DTM provides 25cm/50cm/1m/2m survey rasters, OS Grid/EPSG:27700 and survey-period-specific transformations.
OS Terrain 50 is a 50m-spacing broad-scale terrain model and is only an independent crosscheck, not parcel-range measurement.
